17:31 Local Time, 13:31 GMT, 19:01 IST: Afghanistan showed commendable resolve through an 82-run third-wicket partnership between Sediqullah Atal and Rahmat Shah, but Bangladesh wrested back control late in the day with the prized scalp of Rahmat. Bangladesh will be eager to press home their advantage when play resumes tomorrow. Sediqullah played a remarkably mature knock, displaying solid defensive technique, and his presence will be vital if Afghanistan are to mount a fightback. While a mountain still lies ahead for the hosts, their batters put up a far better fight compared to their first-innings display. The pitch continues to play relatively well for batting, though the odd delivery keeping low remains a lurking threat. Bangladesh's fast bowlers bent their backs and shared the wickets amongst themselves, whereas their spinners looked largely ineffective. Do join us back for the final day's play tomorrow, until then, goodbye and take care!
